message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find the Full Text | |-------|------------|-----------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 45 mph on urban interstates (unless posted otherwise)
• 35 mph on rural highways
• 25 mph on urban highways (unless posted otherwise)
• 20 mph on city streets (unless posted otherwise) | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Seat‑Belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts (§ 545.002).
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster (§ 545.003).
• No “seat‑belt law” for rear‑seat passengers, but child‑safety seat laws apply. | § 545.002–545.003 | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal for drivers over 21 (§ 545.021).
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 % is illegal) (§ 545.021).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | § 545.021 | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (§ 545.021).
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | § 545.021 | | **Driving Under the Influence of Drugs** | • Any drug that impairs driving ability is illegal (§ 545.021).
• Penalties similar to DUI. | § 545.021 | | **Speeding & Reckless Driving** | • Speeding is a misdemeanor; penalties increase with speed over limit.
• Reckless driving (driving with disregard for safety) is a felony (§ 545.021). | § 545.021 | | **Parking & Stop Signs** | • Parking on a curb or in a driveway is prohibited unless a sign allows it (§ 545.021).
• Stop signs must be obeyed; failure is a traffic violation. | § 545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks (§ 545.021).
• At uncontrolled intersections, yield to vehicles on the right (unless a sign indicates otherwise). | § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate (§ 545.021).
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection (except exempt categories). | § 545.021 | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage required: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage (§ 545.021). | § 545.021 | | **Special Rules for Commercial Vehicles** | • Commercial driver’s license (CDL) required for certain vehicles (e.g., > 26,000 lb GVWR).
• Additional regulations on hours of service, load limits, and safety inspections. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021–545.023 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop for school buses with flashing red lights (§ 545.021). | § 545.021 | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Drivers must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens (§ 545.021). | § 545.021 | --- ### How to Access the Full Texas Transportation Code 1. **Texas Legislature Online** – Official source: 2. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)** – Driver’s handbook (includes traffic laws): 3. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Road safety resources: --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re designed for safety, not convenience. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or listen to music. - **Keep your vehicle in good condition** – regular inspections help avoid accidents. - **Stay alert for pedestrians** – especially in urban areas and near schools. - **Know the “no‑handheld” rule** – it applies to all drivers, regardless of age. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular aspect (e.g., “What are the penalties for reckless driving in Texas?” or “How does Texas handle DUI for commercial drivers?”), let me know and I can dive deeper or pull up the exact statutory language.
